_help: Act 7 (Cairo under the countdown) flow for act7.gd. Generated by tools/dialogue/make_act67.py. Not an ActionSpot file.
days: until the thieves countdown runs out (then act7_too_late); 3 actions a day; hotel_bed ends a day (Game.end_day ticks both countdowns)
start: if Hassan is in the party: talk act7_hassan (his confession at trust >= 2)

signs.text: Stage 1: dust hangs in the streets; bad dreams; the city still works.
Stage 2: the sky goes dark by day; shops close, crowds pray. Friendly thieves can now be talked round.
Stage 3: stones fall from the sky; the bazaar shuts; the streets are dangerous.
Stage 4: the sickness; the docks and the station close; the streets empty.
He is in Cairo: catastrophe (game over unless the artifacts are already leaving with you).

events.fight_thieves: the confrontation turned to a fight (their guards: Callahan / Vogel / Bellini's drivers); on a win set artifacts_recovered and start act7_recovered

after: optional: Blackwood at the bank (act7_blackwood, free)
